title: LintRule
description: A single lint rule entry in a lint_rules_<version>.json file (per ADR-0002 §4).

rule_id.description: Unique rule identifier within its kind. Examples: 'W8101' (pylint-odoo), 'no-var' (ESLint), 'BLE001' (ruff).

rule_id_source.description: Provenance of rule_id (issue #364 B4). 'upstream' = rule_id is drawn from and verified to match the real linting tool's own rule registry (the installed pylint-odoo package, the vendored/real ESLint core+plugin rule namespace, or Ruff's own rule/category codes) with the SAME meaning as this record's message. 'osm-local' = rule_id was assigned by OSM curators within the tool's id-naming convention but is NOT a verified real registered id-meaning pair as of the last verification pass. An 'osm-local' id can silently DRIFT INTO a collision as the real tool adds ids over time (see rule_id_collision) - an agent that looks the code up externally may get a different, real rule under the same id.

rule_id_collision.description: Non-null only when rule_id_source='osm-local' AND this exact rule_id string currently denotes a DIFFERENT real rule in the upstream tool's registry as of the verification date recorded here - states that real meaning so the collision is visible in the data instead of latent (issue #364 B4). Null when there is no currently-known collision (osm-local with no verified conflict) or when rule_id_source='upstream' (collision is moot - the id IS the real one).

kind.description: Lint tool kind. 'pylint-odoo' for OCA/pylint-odoo checkers, 'eslint'/'eslint-odoo' for JS, 'ruff-builtin' for ruff rule categories.

message.description: Human-readable description of what this rule checks. Shown in tool output.

severity.description: Severity level: 'error' = must fix, 'warning' = should fix, 'info' = advisory.

file_pattern.description: Glob pattern for files this rule applies to. Null means all files.

fix_template.description: Optional code snippet or prose describing how to fix the violation. Shown in tool fix_template field.

core_symbol_qname.description: Qualified name of the CoreSymbol this rule is associated with (e.g. 'odoo.models.BaseModel.name_get'). Used to MERGE USES_CORE_SYMBOL edge in Neo4j. Null when rule is not tied to a specific API symbol.

code_pattern.description: Python regex applied per-line for deterministic detection. Conventions (ReDoS guard): no nested quantifiers ((.*)*), no sequential lazy quantifiers (.*?...*?...*?) which cause polynomial backtracking, no backreferences; prefer bounded character classes ([^)]*) over unbounded .* between anchors; case-sensitive; matched with re.search per line (the matcher also skips lines longer than its per-line length cap as a defence-in-depth bound). Null when deterministic per-line detection is not feasible (e.g. rules requiring graph/cross-file context).
